Mukesh & Ellammal

Two families, one joyful union — and a lifetime that begins with your blessings.

Selvan S. Mukesh, M.Sc (Micro) , DMLT — Business Officer at Zydus Healthcare Ltd. — is the beloved son of Mrs. S. Kanchana Sivakumar.

Selvi I. Ellammal, B.Com., is the cherished daughter of Mr. E. Iyyappan and Mrs. I. Mohana.

The two families warmly solicit your gracious presence, with family and friends, on the auspicious occasion of their wedding at Pallikonda, Vellore.
